why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Connect a wallet on the Ethermax site Open the Ethermax site and connect your wallet. The game runs on Base, so use a wallet that supports it.
2 Step 2 : Get MAXX for staking or a node The homepage shows MAXX in staking and tells holders to get MAXX ready to set up a validator node. It also has a Buy MAXX link.
3 Step 3 : Read the Ethermax docs The project's docs are its own guide to the game and its two stages. Read them before you start.
4 Step 4 : Mine, stake or refer to earn rewards Choose any of the three activities the docs list for earning. Holders can also set up a validator node, as the homepage banner suggests.
